w10_T4_004207: A recycling depot took in 134 sacks of bottle tops on Monday, and a school collection matched the haul exactly, leaving the depot with 2 sacks for every sack it had. The sorters threw out 115 sacks of contaminated material. Each sack still in the yard was then tipped into 6 bins for colour sorting. The bins were finally shared equally between the 6 art clubs on the depot's list, and the pottery club's share is the one being followed. How many bins does the pottery club get?
w10_T4_004213: On Tuesday morning a comic shop unpacked 102 boxes, and each box held 5 bundles of comics. During the afternoon every bundle was broken open into 7 single comics. In the evening the comics were shared equally between the chain's 3 shops, and the high street shop's share is the one to follow. A collector then sold 52 comics to the high street shop. How many comics does the high street shop have?
w10_T4_004215: A fireworks factory made 100 crates for the festival, and each crate held 8 boxes. Every box was packed with 6 tubes, and each tube contained 7 rockets. The rockets were shared equally between the 6 display sites, and the harbour site's share is the one being followed. During the show 3684 rockets were fired from the harbour site. Half of that site was fenced off for safety, and 250 stewards worked the festival. How many rockets are left at the harbour site?
w10_T4_004220: A print studio pressed 90 sheets of foil, and each sheet made 5 greeting cards. A quality check pulled out 174 cards. A trade order then had the studio print until it held 2 cards for every card it had. A second trade order again had it print until it held 2 cards for every card then in stock. The studio pays 850 a month in rent. How many cards does the studio hold now?
w10_T4_004224: Petra grows more pumpkins than her brother Lukas does. She brought 240 pumpkins to the autumn market, and the stallholder cut each one into 7 wedges. During the day 106 wedges were sold. Lukas contributed 38 wedges from his own crop, and a neighbour added 78 more. The market runs for 12 hours. How many wedges are on the stall at the end?
w10_T4_004228: A rope factory started with 168 coils of twine, and 81 coils were sold to a chandler. Each coil still in the store was wound onto 6 reels. Every reel was then cut into 9 lengths, and each length was chopped into 4 short cords. A customer later returned 11 cords. The factory measures its cord in metres although the labels are printed in centimetres. How many cords does the factory have?
w10_T4_004230: A stables had 75 bales of hay stacked in the barn. Rain spoiled 6 bales before they were covered. The supplier then delivered 5 bales for every bale still in the barn. A neighbour dropped off 6 more bales on his way home. Over the winter the horses ate 199 bales, and half of the barn roof was replaced in October. How many bales are in the barn now?
w10_T4_004234: Amara knits more squares each month than her friend Rosalind does. She bought 131 skeins of wool, and each skein made 5 squares for a blanket. Rosalind gave her 3 finished squares, and a knitting group donated 48 more. A charity then asked for that same blanket to be made for each of the 8 shelters it supports, needing that many squares for every shelter. How many squares are needed altogether?
w10_T4_004238: A festival kitchen had 138 sacks of rice, which were shared equally between the 3 food tents; the curry tent's share is the one being followed. A late delivery added 68 sacks to the curry tent. The cooks then split the tent's sacks equally between the 6 days of the festival, and the opening day's allocation is the one to follow. Each sack in that allocation fills 9 serving pots. How many serving pots does the opening day have?
w10_T4_004242: A hotel laundry started the week with 118 sets of bed linen, and 12 sets came back from the repair room. A guesthouse that was closing down sold the hotel 44 more sets. The owner then bought in enough new linen for the hotel to hold 2 sets for every set counted so far. Over the summer 312 sets were worn out and thrown away. How many sets of bed linen does the hotel have?
w10_T4_004243: On Friday morning a wholesaler had 63 boxes of screws, and a delivery added 33 more before noon. At lunchtime 55 boxes went out to a builder. In the early afternoon each remaining box was opened into 4 packets. Later every packet was split into 4 small bags. In the evening each bag was counted and found to hold 9 screws. How many screws does the wholesaler have?
w10_T4_004250: On Monday morning a rail depot had 101 trolleys, and each trolley carried 6 parcels. Before noon a van added 53 parcels, and a corner shop handed over 19 more. In the early afternoon 43 damaged parcels were taken out of the pile. Later that afternoon a post office sent over 27 parcels. In the evening head office ran that same round in each of the 5 districts it serves, sending that many parcels to every district. The depot quotes delivery windows in hours although the drivers record their stops in minutes. How many parcels went out across all the districts?
w10_T4_004258: Selma bottles more cider than her cousin Iker does. She pressed 185 barrels, and each barrel filled 7 casks. A leak lost 63 casks, and a pub chain bought 809 of them. A festival took another 337 casks, and Iker later returned 21 casks refilled from his own press. The cellar is kept at 12 degrees, and the trade lists volumes in litres although the casks are stamped in millilitres. How many casks does Selma have now?
w10_T4_004260: Jonah keeps more chess sets in his club store than Beatriz keeps in hers. He counted 177 sets, and a school donated 34 more. Beatriz passed him 29 sets she no longer used. A tournament sponsor then supplied 4 sets for every set in Jonah's store. A late parcel added 7 further sets, and the club room holds 60 tables. How many sets are in Jonah's store now?
w10_T4_004261: On Thursday morning a button factory ran 153 spools, and each spool produced 8 buttons. Before lunch 314 buttons failed the shine test and were scrapped. In the early afternoon a second machine was switched on, leaving 2 buttons for every button made so far. Later that afternoon the plating line turned out 5 buttons for each of those. In the evening a supplier delivered 40 spare buttons. Overnight 1329 buttons were shipped to a clothing firm, and the factory floor covers 900 square metres. How many buttons are in the factory now?
w10_T4_004264: A campsite had 168 bundles of firewood at the start of the week, and a forester delivered 71 more. Damp ruined 2 bundles in the corner of the shed. A scout group donated 59 bundles, and a sawmill sent over 75. Half of the woodshed is used for tools, and the site advertises its fire pits in hours although the wardens log them in minutes. How many bundles of firewood does the campsite have?
w10_T4_004266: On Saturday morning a museum shop had 35 model dinosaurs, and 29 were bought by a school group. Before lunch a supplier delivered 27 more. In the afternoon head office restocked the shelf, sending 5 models for every model standing on it. During the evening event 147 models were sold. Overnight the warehouse rebuilt the display with 9 models for every model left, and half of the shop window is given over to the exhibition poster. How many models are in the shop now?
w10_T4_004278: A swimming club had 62 lane floats in its store. The council donated 38 floats, and 61 floats were sent off to the summer camp. A neighbouring club lent 53 floats for the gala, and a sponsor supplied 66 brand-new ones. How many floats are in the club's store now?
w10_T4_004280: Marek keeps more houseplants than his flatmate Dita does. He started with 89 cuttings on the windowsill. He gave 71 cuttings away at a plant swap, 9 died in the cold, 2 were knocked off the sill, and Dita took 6 for her own room. A nursery then rooted 6 new plants from every cutting Marek had left. Half of the windowsill is free now, and the nursery quotes growing times in months although the labels give them in weeks. How many plants did the nursery root for Marek?
w10_T4_004281: Halima takes more stall space at the craft fair than her colleague Rui does. She began the season with 239 wooden toys, and her workshop delivered 57 more. Rui handed over 36 toys he had not sold. A department store then placed an order that took her book to 4 toys for every toy she held, and a catalogue firm followed with one that took it to 5 toys for each of those. A school added a final order of 80 toys. The firm quotes production times in weeks although the workshop plans in days. How many toys are in Halima's order book?
w10_T4_004282: A bottling plant had 125 pallets of empties, and a supplier delivered 31 more pallets. Each pallet was unloaded into 9 trays, and a returned order added 36 trays to the line. The contents of every tray then filled 5 crates, and each crate was packed with 5 bottles. The plant measures its output in litres although the bottles themselves are marked in millilitres. How many bottles did the plant fill?
w10_T4_004283: A theatre workshop had 184 metres of cable in store, and 12 metres were cut away as frayed. A supplier delivered 16 metres, and a theatre that was closing donated 47 metres. The company then ordered the same length again for each of its 4 touring sets, needing that much cable per set. How many metres of cable does the company need altogether?
w10_T4_004286: Dmitri raises more carp than his neighbour Ana does. His pond held 99 fish, and a hatchery added 61 more. The hatchery then bred 5 young fish for every fish in the pond and put them all in. A heron took 398 fish over the summer, and Ana restocked the pond with 80 of her own. The pond is 3 metres deep at the middle. How many fish are in Dmitri's pond now?
w10_T4_004293: A tool library had 85 drills on its shelves, and a donation added 9 more. Members borrowed 55 drills, and 30 were sent away for servicing. A grant then paid for 7 drills for every drill still on the shelf. A hardware chain donated 20 further drills, and the library opens 4 days a week. How many drills are on the shelf now?
w10_T4_004298: A choir bought 26 songbooks, and a member donated 34 more. Each songbook contained 9 songs. The choir divided the songs evenly into 2 equal programmes, and the spring programme is the one being followed. It then performed that programme in each of 5 towns, singing that many songs in every town, and the choir has 48 members. How many songs were sung across the whole tour?
